tolerance.note: push forces from bisection; must match exactly up to rounding

config.name: Single pendulum on cart – angle + cart loops
config.description: Angle loop plus a cart-position loop, robust gains from the auto-tuner (recovers from ≈5 N tip pushes). Note the negative-looking behaviour of the cart loop: to return to the centre the cart first moves away (non-minimum-phase).

config.name: Double pendulum on cart – multi-loop (LQR seeded)
config.description: Two segments balanced by three parallel loops (cart, θ1, θ2). Robust auto-tuned gains: recovers from tip pushes up to ≈0.5 N (0.1 s).

config.name: Single pendulum, base motor – PID
config.description: Fixed pivot with a torque motor (reverse-acting PID). Try lowering D to see oscillations, or raising P to see faster, more aggressive recovery.
